title: Assetto Corsa
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.10
notes: Works end to end with two things in place: install the .NET Framework 4.8 dependency first (bottle settings → Dependencies; takes 20-40 min and looks frozen — let it finish), and use the D3DMetal renderer. The stock launcher is a 32-bit .NET/WPF app: without .NET it dies silently, which was the long-standing 'AC won't launch' failure. With .NET it renders fully and practice sessions run (verified 2026-08-28, fullscreen 1728x1117, clean exit; fps not measured). DXMT black-screens the session (engine runs, never paints) — if you get a black screen on session start, switch the bottle to D3DMetal, stop all bottle processes, and relaunch. Launcher news panels may spin forever; cosmetic.
